blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Protein language models (pLMs) are powerful tools for protein annotation and mutation-effect prediction, but progress has largely depended on scaling model size and data, making them expensive and prone to memorization. Test-time scaling offers a complementary path, but methods developed for autoregressive LLMs do not transfer directly: masked encoders lack a generation loop, and amino acids do not verbalize in a reasoning language. Instead, we adapt recursive pretraining to masked pLMs, where a weight-tied Transformer core refines residue-aligned hidden states over an adjustable number of cycles. We instantiate this recipe as recAMPLIFY, a pLM with 155M unique parameters trained on the same 2T tokens as AMPLIFY-350M. Despite 56% fewer parameters, it improves CASP contact recovery and three out of four supervised tasks, notably raising fold accuracy by 22.5%. Because optimal depth for recAMPLIFY varies across tasks and assays, we then introduce Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR), a framework that decodes each protein from a probability-weighted mixture of hidden states visited during recursion. GMR employs a learned residual gate at scalar, low-rank, or per-dimension resolution to control how much of each cycle's proposed update is accepted into the state. This unifies halting and gating into a single adaptive computation objective while recovering PonderNet-style halting as a special case without gates. Layered on top of recAMPLIFY, GMR further reduces expected layer depth by up to 37%, although the accuracy trade-off varies by task. Mechanistic analyses show that residual gating controls recurrence stability beyond the trained depth and that halt depth tracks biological properties.
blocks.zh: 蛋白质语言模型(pLM)是蛋白质注释和突变效应预测的强大工具,但进展很大程度上依赖于模型大小和数据的缩放,使得模型价格昂贵并容易被记起. 测试时间缩放提供了一条互补路径,但为自递回式LLMs所开发的方法并不直接传输:被遮蔽的编码器缺乏一代循环,氨基酸不会用推理语言口语化. 相反,我们调整了递归性预演,以适应被遮住的pLM,在其中,一个有重力的变形器芯能将残留相通的隐藏状态精炼出可调节的周期数. 我们用ReAMPLIFY来即兴制作这个配方, 这个配有155M独特参数的pLM, 与AMPLIFY-350M一样, 尽管参数少了56%,但它改进了CASP接触恢复和4个监督任务中的3个,主要是将折叠精度提高了22.5%. 由于累加AMPLIFY的最佳深度因任务和化验而异,我们随后引入了Gated Mixture Recurence(GMR),这个框架从复发期间访问的被概率加权混合的隐藏状态中解码出每个蛋白质. GMR在分级,低等或每分解分解时使用一个有学识的剩余门来控制每个周期建议的更新中有多少被接受进入状态. 这统一了停止并成为一个单一的适应性计算目标,同时恢复PonderNet式的停止作为没有门的特殊情况。 在累加AMPLIFY上分层,GMR进一步将预期地层深度降低至37%,尽管准确度的取舍因任务而异. 机械分析表明,残留的地标控制了超过训练有素深度的再生稳定性,并阻止了深度跟踪生物特性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Proteins are sequences of amino acids shaped by evolutionary pressure to code diverse biological functions, including the ability to form specific folded structures. Protein language models (pLMs) attempt to learn these constraints directly from sequence ( Rives et al., 2021 ; Elnaggar et al., 2022 ; Nijkamp et al., 2023 ; Ferruz et al., 2022 ) , typically using bidirectional Transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) encoders trained with masked language modeling (MLM) ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) . By predicting masked residues from their surrounding context, these models must capture essential interactions, including those that are far apart in sequence but close in 3 3 D space. The resulting conditional distributions enable zero-shot mutation scoring and contact recovery, while contextual representations enable downstream classification and regression tasks.

blocks.en: Recent progress in pLMs has largely been driven by scaling both model size and training data ( Lin et al., 2023 ; Nijkamp et al., 2023 ; Candido et al., 2026 ) . However, parameter count alone does not determine performance. AMPLIFY- 350 350 M ( Fournier et al., 2024 ) , despite having 43 × 43\times fewer parameters than ESM- 2 2 15 15 B ( Lin et al., 2023 ) , achieves comparable pseudo-perplexity on its curated validation set and better residue recovery on the human proteome. Several works further indicate that scaling can lead to undesirable memorization in larger pLMs ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Fournier et al., 2024 ; Hou et al., 2026 ) . These observations motivate test-time scaling and adaptive computation as complementary axes to increase compute while keeping the number of parameters fixed.

blocks.en: Test-time compute scaling in autoregressive LLMs typically relies either on generating verbalized reasoning tokens ( Wei et al., 2022 ) or iteratively updating continuous latent states ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ; Giannou et al., 2023 ; Hao et al., 2025 ) . For masked pLMs with no autoregressive generation loop, the discrete-token approach does not transfer. Furthermore, amino-acid sequences do not admit verbalized rationales, and inserting thought tokens would break the residue-to-state alignment required for masked prediction. In contrast, iterative refinement of continuous latent representations, hereafter latent refinement, offers a natural way to increase pLM computation. Latent refinement already has a strong precedent in protein structure prediction, where AlphaFold ( Jumper et al., 2021 ) and ESMFold ( Lin et al., 2023 ) recycle internal representations for a predefined number of cycles. However, these recycles operate on structural rather than sequence representations, leaving input-dependent test-time latent refinement unexplored in pLMs.
blocks.zh: 在自递性LLMs中,测试时间计算缩放通常取决于生成口语化推理符号(Wei等,2022年)或迭接更新连续潜伏状态(Dehghani等,2019年;Giannou等,2023年;Hao等,2025年)。 对于没有自旋生成回路的被遮住的pLM来说,离散键方法不传输. 此外,氨基酸序列不接受口语化的理由,插入思想符号会打破遮掩预测所需的残留物与状态相配. 相形之下,连续潜在表示的迭接性完善(以下简称潜在完善)为增加pLM计算提供了自然途径. 在蛋白质结构预测中,Lententnt的改进已经有一个很强的先例,其中AlphaFold(Juffer等,2021年)和EMEFold(Lin等,2023年)对内部代表进行循环,以预设的周期数. 然而,这些再生利用在结构上而不是在序列上进行,使得依赖输入的试验时间潜在的精度在pLM中没有得到探讨.

blocks.en: To approach test-time latent refinement, we hold a set of parameters as a recurrent unit ( Nakano, 1972 ; Amari, 1972 ) that iteratively refines its hidden states in a recursive fashion. Building on depth-recurrent language models ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ; Giannou et al., 2023 ; Geiping et al., 2025 ) , we adapt a recursive pretraining framework for test-time scaling in pLMs. Applied to AMPLIFY, this framework yields recursive AMPLIFY (recAMPLIFY) that separates effective model depth from unique parameter count. In recAMPLIFY, a non-recurrent prelude first maps token embeddings into a residue-aligned latent representation space where recursion can be unrolled. A weight-tied core refines this state over a number of recurrent cycles, increasing compute without changing sequence length or residue alignment. A non-recurrent coda then maps the refined state to the MLM output space for masked-residue prediction (Figure 1 ). Because the core can be reapplied, the number of recurrent cycles, and therefore the effective depth, remains adjustable after pretraining. 1 1 1 We define depth recurrence as the architectural mechanism of repeatedly applying a weight-tied block and recursive computation as the resulting strategy of increasing effective depth through repeated latent refinement.
blocks.zh: 为了接近测试时间潜在改进,我们持有一套参数,作为一个经常性单元(中野,1972;阿马里,1972),以递归的方式反复地完善其隐藏状态。 基于深度-经常性语言模型(Dehghani等,2019;Giannou等,2023;Geiping等,2025),我们调整了PLM中测试时间缩放的回溯性预训框架. 应用于AMPLIFY,这个框架产生递归性的AMPLIFY(recAMPLIFY),将有效的模型深度与独特的参数计数区分开来. 在RecAMPLIFY中,一个非经常性的序曲先行图符号会嵌入到可不卷入的残基相通的潜在表示空间. 重心能通过一些循环来完善这种状态,在不改变序列长度或残留相接的情况下增加计算. 然后,一个非经常性的coda将被精制状态映射到MLM输出空间,用于遮掩的还原预测(图一. 由于核心可以被再应用,所以重复周期的数量,因此有效深度,在预训后仍然可以被调整. 1个 1. 我们把深度再现定义为反复采用加权制块和递归式计算的结构机制,作为通过再三潜在改进来增加有效深度的战略。

blocks.en: Exposing recurrence depth as a test-time variable leaves open how to allocate the compute budget across inputs: fixed-depth recursion applies the same number of cycles to every input, yet we observe task- and assay-specific performance optima rather than monotonic gains from more cycles (Figures 2 and 3(b) ). An effective recursion mechanism should thus decide both when to stop the update and how each cycle’s update should shape the hidden state. Recent work in limited data regimes addresses the when question by training halting heads from verifiable answers ( Jolicoeur-Martineau, 2025 ) . However, no such verifier exists for MLM since determining which residues are biologically valid at a masked position is itself the problem the pLM is being trained to solve. Instead, we propose Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR), which decodes from a probability-weighted mixture of the hidden states visited during recursion and gates each cycle’s residual update by a learned survival signal at a scalar , low-rank , or per-dimension channel resolution. When the state update is ungated and the decode weights come from an independent halt head, we recover PonderNet-style halting ( Banino et al., 2021 ) as a special case of GMR. By unifying halt and gate into one framework, every learned GMR survival makes the recurrence trajectory itself input-adaptive, with the three gate resolutions progressing from coarser sequence-wide to finer feature-resolved control.
blocks.zh: 将重现深度作为测试时间变量来展示,将如何将计算预算分配给所有投入:固定深度重现对每项投入适用相同的周期数,然而我们观察到的是任务和实验特定的性能选择图,而不是更多周期的单调收益(图2和3(b))。 因此,有效的再现机制应决定何时停止更新,以及每个周期的更新如何塑造隐藏状态。 最近,在有限的数据制度中开展的工作,通过培训不再提供可核查的答案(Jolicoeur-Martineau,2025年)来解决问题。 然而,MLM没有这种核查器,因为确定哪些残留物在被遮蔽的位置具有生物有效性本身就是PLM正在接受训练以加以解决的问题。 相反,我们提出“Ged Mixture Recurence ” ( GMR ) , 即通过在平分、低分或平分通道分辨率上学习到的生存信号,从重现期间所访问的隐形状态的概率加权混合物中解码出每个周期的剩余更新。 当状态更新被加注,解码权重来自一个独立的停机头时,我们恢复了PonderNet-style stop(Banino等,2021年)作为GMR的特例. 通过将阻断和闸门统一为一个框架,每个学习到的GMR活性使重现轨迹本身具有输入-适应性,三个闸门分辨率从宽窄序列向更细的地物溶解控制推进.

blocks.en: Our experiments on zero-shot and supervised probes show that recAMPLIFY with 155 155 M unique parameters, after being pretrained on the same 2 2 T tokens, remains competitive with the best performing AMPLIFY- 350 350 M with 56 56 % fewer unique parameters. Namely, recAMPLIFY improves fold accuracy by 22.5 % 22.5\% (from 56.8 % 56.8\% to 69.6 % 69.6\% ) and localization accuracy by 3.5 3.5 % (from 71.6 % 71.6\% to 74.1 % 74.1\% ). It also outperforms the similar-sized AMPLIFY- 120 120 M across supervised probes by up to 23 23 %. We further observe that more recursion is not always better: recAMPLIFY trained with fixed recurrence depth can degrade beyond the recursion horizon seen during training. While variable-depth pretraining improves robustness to unseen depths, it does not provide a single optimal test-time depth. In contrast, GMR enables adaptive recursion while reducing the expected number of recurrent cycles by 32 32 – 40 40 % relative to a recAMPLIFY trained with six cycles, while improving CASP contact recovery and most supervised probes at a small cost in zero-shot DMS and KL calibration. Our mechanistic analyses further show that residual gating, rather than halting alone, stabilizes recurrence beyond the trained horizon, while the expected halt depth reflects a sequence’s composition entropy. Our main contributions are:

blocks.en: • We introduce a recursive pretraining framework for test-time scaling in masked pLMs by separating effective depth from unique parameter count. • We propose recAMPLIFY, a recursive pLM with 56 56 % fewer unique parameters than AMPLIFY- 350 350 M, and show its competitiveness on downstream tasks after training on the same 2 2 T tokens. • To enable adaptive recursion in recAMPLIFY, we propose Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR), a unified framework that decodes from a mixture over recurrence-depth hidden states and gates their updates by a learned survival at scalar, low-rank, or per-dimension resolution. • We characterize the recurrent dynamics and the biological signal learned by recAMPLIFY, showing residual gating to stabilize recurrence and adaptive depth to track biological properties.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: ESM-1b ( Rives et al., 2021 ) , ProtTrans ( Elnaggar et al., 2022 ) , and ESM-2 ( Lin et al., 2023 ) established that unsupervised protein representations discover aspects of structure, function, and variant-effect prediction. AMPLIFY ( Fournier et al., 2024 ) showed that data curation and architecture can matter more than parameter count. Iterative refinement is not new to protein modeling either. The folding trunks of AlphaFold ( Jumper et al., 2021 ) and ESMFold ( Lin et al., 2023 ) repeatedly refine sequence and pair representations. However, these recycles belong to a supervised structure-prediction trunk and use a globally chosen count. Instead, we pretrain with recurrence inside the sequence encoder, and study both fixed and input-dependent test-time depth.
blocks.zh: 无害环境管理-1b(Rives等人,2021年),ProtTrans (Elnaggar等人,2022年),和ESM-2(Lin等人,2023年)确定,无监督的蛋白质表达会发现结构,功能,和变异效应预测等各方面. AMPLIFY(Fournier等,2024年)表明,数据校正和架构可以比参数计数更重要. 对蛋白质模型的活性改进也不是新鲜事。 AlphaFold(Juffer等,2021年)和EMEFold(Lin等,2023年)的折叠干线反复细化了序列和对表示. 然而,这些再循环属于受监督的结构预测干线,并使用全球选定的计数。 相反,我们预演序列编码器内部的再生,研究固定和输入依赖的测试-时间深度.

blocks.en: Popular methods for scaling language models with fixed parameter count include repeated sampling ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Baek et al., 2026 ) , chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , or both ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Yoran et al., 2023 ) . Nevertheless, these come with their own trade-offs. Repeated sampling needs additional verifiers for assessing candidates, which is not always possible for scientific discovery tasks ( Cornelio et al., 2026 ) . CoT reasoning calls for committing to discrete verbalized tokens. Addressing these pitfalls, a third scaling axis involves thinking recursively in continuous latent spaces ( Amari, 1972 ; Hao et al., 2025 ) . Universal ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ) and Looped Transformers ( Giannou et al., 2023 ) approach this through a weight-tied, iterative refinement lineage ( Liao and Poggio, 2016 ) . Given the effectiveness of recursive thinking for limited data regimes ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Jolicoeur-Martineau, 2025 ; Liao and Poggio, 2026 ) and how it helps compact models with better learning priors ( Schwarzschild et al., 2021 ; Bansal et al., 2022 ; Kohli et al., 2026 ) , we hypothesize that weight-tied recurrence is crucial for scaling compact pLMs, where larger models are known to memorize training data ( Fournier et al., 2024 ) . A desirable property for such recurrence is adaptive computation ( Graves, 2016 ) that refines the latent state in an input-dependent manner ( Blayney et al., 2026 ; Fein-Ashley and Rashidinejad, 2026 ) . Here, a halting head can be trained either in a supervised ( Jolicoeur-Martineau, 2025 ) or self-supervised manner ( Banino et al., 2021 ) to recognize convergence. For a pLM encoder, supervised halting requires a verifier to recognize which residues are valid at each masked position, which is exactly the biology the model is being trained to learn. We thus adopt the latter self-supervised objective.
blocks.zh: 具有固定参数计数的语言模型的流行方法包括重复采样(Cobbe等,2021;Baek等,2026),思维链(CoT)推理(Wei等,2022),或两者兼有(Wang等,2023;Yoran等,2023). 尽管如此,这些是它们自己的取舍。 重复采样需要额外的验证器来评估候选者,而科学发现任务并不总是可能的(Cornelio等,2026.). CoT推理要求承诺使用离散的口音符号. 解决这些陷阱,第三个缩放轴涉及在连续的潜在空间中进行回向思考(Amari,1972年;Hao等,2025年)。 通用 (Dehghani等,2019年)和"环形变形"(Giannou等,2023年)通过重心相接,迭接的完善线条(廖和波吉奥,2016年)来看待这个问题. 鉴于对有限数据制度的回溯性思维的有效性(Wang等,2025年;Jolicoeur-Martineau,2025年;Liao和Poggio,2026年),以及这种思维如何帮助有更好学习前科的紧凑模型(Schwarzschild等,2021年;Bansal等,2022年;Kohli等,2026年),我们假设,加权重迭对于压缩pLM(已知较大型模型可记忆培训数据)至关重要(Fournier等,2024年)。 这种再现的一个可取属性是适应性计算(Graves,2016年),该计算以依赖输入的方式完善了潜在状态(Blayney等,2026;Fein-Ashley和Rashidinejad,2026年)。 在这里,停站头可以接受受监督(Jolicoeur-Martineau,2025年)或自我监督(Banino等,2021年)的训练,以识别趋同. 对于pLM编码器,有监督的停止要求核查者确认哪些残留物在每个被遮蔽的位置是有效的,这正是该模型正在被训练去学习的生物学. 因此,我们采纳了后一项自我监督的目标。

blocks.en: Depth recurrence defines a learned dynamical system whose hidden states can converge or oscillate, and where additional iterations can degrade a previously useful representation. Prior work links successful depth extrapolation to input recall ( Bansal et al., 2022 ) , path-independent attractors ( Anil et al., 2022 ; Geiping et al., 2025 ) , and stable cyclic fixed points ( Prairie et al., 2026 ) , and identifies “overthinking” beyond the trained depth as a recurring failure mode ( Kohli et al., 2026 ; Blayney et al., 2026 ) . These studies treat recursion dynamics, such as depth sweeps, state changes, output convergence, and evolutionary properties, as operational rather than interpretive. We build on these works in our analysis of gated recurrence and protein properties.
blocks.zh: 深度重现定义了一个被学习到的动态系统,其隐藏状态可以聚合或吞噬,而额外的迭代可以降解之前有用的表示. 先前的工作将成功的深度推断与投入回顾联系起来(Bansal等,2022年),路径独立吸引者 (Anil等,2022;Geiping等,2025),以及稳定的循环固定点(Prairie等,2026),并将训练深度外的“过度思考”确定为重复性故障模式(Kohli等,2026;Blayney等,2026)。 这些研究将回溯动态,如深度扫描,状态变化,输出趋同,和演化属性等视为可操作性而非可解释性. 我们在分析门类再生和蛋白质特性时,以这些工作为基础。

blocks.en: 3 Problem Setup
blocks.zh: 3 个问题设置

blocks.en: We formulate test-time scaling for masked pLMs using AMPLIFY ( Fournier et al., 2024 ) , whose released pretraining data, code and architecture recipe enable controlled comparisons under a fixed data budget. Let S = ( a 1 , … , a T ) S=(a_{1},\ldots,a_{T}) denote a protein sequence of length T T , where a i a_{i} denotes the residue at position i i , drawn from the alphabet of 20 standard amino acids. AMPLIFY pretrains a pre-norm Transformer encoder f f by minimizing the masked-token cross-entropy ℒ MLM \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MLM}} to recover masked residues from a bidirectional context. Its hidden states remain in one-to-one alignment with the input residues, supporting masked-marginal mutation scoring and frozen-embedding probes. We seek to build a recursive AMPLIFY encoder whose inference-time computation can be increased per protein without changing its unique parameter count or disrupting residue alignment. To this end, we expose the number L L of applications of a weight-tied Transformer core as a test-time variable. This allows the model to iteratively refine its residue-aligned latent state under varying compute budgets.

AMPLIFY通过最小化被遮住的相交式LMLM{Mathcal{L}_{\-mathrm{MLM}来回收双向上下文中被遮住的残渣来预取出一个预规范变形器编码器f. 其隐藏状态与输入残留保持一对一的对接,支持遮掩-边缘突变积分和被冻结-嵌入探测器. 我们寻求建立一个递归的AMPLIFY编码器,其推论时间计算可以增加每个蛋白质,而无需改变其独特的参数计数或中断残留的对齐. 为此,我们暴露出一个重齿变形器核心作为测试时间变量的应用的LL数字. 这使该模型能够在不同的计算预算下反复地完善其与残留物相匹配的潜在状态。

blocks.en: Proteins vary widely in biological complexity, from short signal peptides to multi-domain enzymes and from structured domains to intrinsically disordered chains. pLMs must accommodate diverse proteins, and the per-assay optima suggest that no single recurrence depth is optimal across all proteins (Figure 2 ). These observations motivate learning a recurrence depth budget that adapts to each sequence. We thus seek a recursive pLM that can allocate compute adaptively while preserving stable latent dynamics. We then study whether its expected halt depth carries interpretable information about proteins.
blocks.zh: 蛋白质在生物复杂度上差异很大,从短信号peptides到多域酶,从结构域到内在无序链. pLM必须能容纳多种蛋白质,而每例实验的optima显示,没有单一的重现深度是所有蛋白质中最佳的(图2 ). 这些观察促使人们学习一个适应每个序列的再现深度预算。 因此,我们寻求一个递归性pLM,可以适应性地分配计算,同时保持稳定的潜在动力。 然后,我们研究它的预期停止深度是否包含可解释的蛋白质信息。

blocks.en: Following AMPLIFY’s pretraining recipe and using its publicly released code and data ( Fournier et al., 2024 ) , we pretrain recAMPLIFY on the same mixture of the UniRef100 ( Suzek et al., 2007 ) , SCOP ( Murzin et al., 1995 ) , and OAS ( Olsen et al., 2022 ) databases, making the original AMPLIFY our direct baseline. Further details are provided in § B .
blocks.zh: 根据AMPLIFY的预训食谱,并使用其公开发布的代码和数据(Fournier等人,2024年),我们对UniRef100(Suzek等人,2007年),SCOP(Murzin等人,1995年)和OAS(Olsen等人,2022年)数据库的同一种混合物进行再培训,从而使最初的AMPLIFY成为我们的直接基准。 详见B节。

blocks.en: Following Lin et al. (2023) , we evaluate using two types of probes. Zero-shot probes: KL calibration ( Le Breton et al., 2026 ) , ProteinGym DMS ( Notin et al., 2023 ) , and CASP16 contact recovery ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . Supervised probes: we use the 18 18 -task benchmark of Chen et al. (2025) and study four representative tasks reported to show clear benefits from pretraining ( Le Breton et al., 2026 ) : fold accuracy ( Rao et al., 2019 ) , localization accuracy ( Dallago et al., 2021 ) , stability prediction ( Rao et al., 2019 ; Dallago et al., 2021 ) , and secondary-structure prediction (SSP) ( Rao et al., 2019 ) . For each supervised task, we report the mean test performance over 5 5 seeds after re-training the best configuration from a 50 50 -trial Bayesian TPE hyperparameter search. Further evaluation and hyperparameter details are provided in § C .
blocks.zh: 继Lin等 (2023)后,我们使用两种探测器进行评估. 零射出探测器:KL校正(Le Breton等,2026年),蛋白质Gym DMS(Notin等,2023年),CASP16接触恢复(Yuan等,2026年). 监督探测器:我们使用陈等的18-18任务基准(2025年),并研究报告的四个代表性任务,以显示预训(Le Breton等,2026年)的明显好处:折叠精度(Rao等,2019年),本地化精度(Dallago等,2021年),稳定性预测(Rao等,2019年;Dallago等,2021年)和二级结构预测(SSP)(Rao等,2019年). 每一个受监督的任务,我们报告5个种子的平均测试性能,然后通过50个实验的贝叶斯TPE超参数搜索对最佳配置进行再培训。 进一步评价和超参数详细情况载于C节。

blocks.en: We first examine whether the minimal recurrent design of recAMPLIFY remains viable at the full pLM pretraining scale of 1 1 M steps. For a fair comparison, we match AMPLIFY- 350 350 M’s 15 15 attention heads and a hidden dimension of 960 960 , and set the number of layers to ( p , r , c ) = ( 2 , 10 , 2 ) (p,r,c)=(2,10,2) , i.e., roughly the budget of the compact AMPLIFY- 120 120 M baseline. Table 1 shows that recAMPLIFY, with 155 155 M unique parameters, remains competitive with AMPLIFY- 350 350 M across downstream probes when both are trained on the same 2 2 T tokens. The clearest gains appear on the four supervised probe tasks that most reliably measure information acquired during pretraining. Visualizing the coda embeddings across recurrent cycles (Figure 3(a) ) shows that each additional cycle brings the embedding manifold closer to the downstream label geometry, improving 5 5 -NN accuracy. Finally, we verify that the cost of our recursive pretraining recipe scales with depth alone. Table 4 shows that our 133 133 M recAMPLIFY at L = 3 L=3 achieves measured effective throughput comparable to AMPLIFY- 350 350 M, which has approximately 2.7 × 2.7\times as many unique parameters.

blocks.en: A direct comparison with ESM-2 is confounded by differences in model size and pretraining data: its larger checkpoints have 4 4 – 18 × 18\times as many parameters as recAMPLIFY and use an earlier UniRef release with a different clustering scheme. ESM-2 samples uniformly over UniRef50 clusters, whereas AMPLIFY’s UniRef100 recipe retains more of the observed sequence redundancy, resulting in different training distributions (§ B ). ESM-2’s unreleased pretraining code and exact data splits also make reproducing its training setup difficult. With these caveats, larger ESM-2 checkpoints outperform recAMPLIFY on three out of four supervised probes, while recAMPLIFY exceeds ESM-2- 650 650 M and 3 3 B on stability prediction and achieves better target (T) KL calibration than ESM-2- 150 150 M and 650 650 M.

blocks.en: The per-layer step norms in Figures 5 a and 12 a reveal three distinct behaviors. Recurrence without GMR shows no consistent limiting behavior, although input injection keeps it bounded (Figure 11 ). Halt-only GMR changes only when updates stop, not the underlying step size. blocks.en: Next, we extend this test from per-protein composition to per-gene identity, and study how GMR depth varies across alternative splice-isoforms of the same human gene. Across 335 335 human genes and 1,054 1{,}054 isoforms, same-gene isoforms cluster nearly twice as tightly in halt depth as size-matched random pairs of proteins (Table ). This gap indicates that gates do not follow a fixed, input-independent decay schedule. Instead, the input governs the gate trajectory, at least at gene granularity. Moreover, what gates read is a property of the shared backbone rather than of exact residues since alternative isoforms differ only by one included or excluded functional domain, and 𝔼 ⁡ [ k ] \mathbb{E}[k] consistently tracks the compositional constraint of the retained portion across all family members (see § F for details).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced recursive pretraining for test-time compute scaling in masked pLMs. With 56 % 56\% fewer unique parameters, the resulting recAMPLIFY improves CASP contact recovery, fold, localization and stability over AMPLIFY- 350 350 M while remaining close on DMS and non-target KL calibration. Our Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR) unifies self-supervised halting and residual gating into one adaptive computation framework, reducing the expected per-protein cycle count by 32 32 – 40 % 40\% while improving contact recovery and most supervised probes over fixed-depth recursion. Mechanistically, scalar and per-dimension gates drive the recurrent state toward an empirical fixed point beyond the trained horizon, and only per-dimension gating recovers the feedforward layerwise mixing profile. Finally, after controlling for length and model confidence, halt depth tracks sequence entropy and hydrophobic composition, making it an interpretable compute allocator.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了循环预训 测试时间计算缩放 在面具的pLM。 由于56%的56分小于独有参数,由此产生的回转AMPLIFY在AMPLIFY-350350M上改善了CASP接触恢复,折叠,本地化和稳定性,同时保持了DMS和非目标KL校正. 我们的Ged Mixture Recurence(GMR)将自我监督的停止和剩余分解成一个适应性计算框架,将每颗蛋白质循环的预期数减少32 32 — 40% — 40 — — 4 % — — ,同时改善接触恢复和大多数在固定深度重现上的受监督探测。 从机械角度来说,分级和分层门 将重复状态推向一个经验性的固定点 超越训练的地平线 只有分层格子才能恢复向上分层的分层 最后,在控制了长度和模型置信度之后,停止了深度轨道序列 en和疏水成分,使其成为可解释的计算分解器.

blocks.en: We pretrain on a mixture of three corpora: UniRef 100 100 [ Suzek et al., 2007 ] for the general proteome, SCOP [ Chandonia et al., 2022 ] for structural domain diversity, and OAS [ Olsen et al., 2022 ] for antibody sequences. During training, we do not apply explicit resampling or per-corpus weighting. Each sequence therefore appears in the training stream in proportion to the raw size of its source corpus, so UniRef 100 100 contributes the vast majority of samples, while SCOP and OAS increase structural and antibody coverage. Training batches are formed by a token-budget sampler that greedily packs variable-length sequences into blocks of 32,768 32{,}768 tokens per device, with per-epoch shuffling over the concatenated index, so every batch is a well-mixed sample drawn across all three corpora. The three held-out validation splits are evaluated separately, yielding one perplexity (PPL) curve per corpus (Figure 4(a) ).

blocks.en: Fournier et al. [2024] argue that UniRef50, obtained by clustering UniRef100 at 50 % 50\% identity, systematically distorts the natural sequence distribution in three ways. First, cluster size in UniRef100 is an observational signal. Since large clusters correspond to families for which many related sequences have been deposited, their redundancy reflects real evidence for the underlying subspace of the fitness landscape. However, 50 % 50\% -identity clustering discards this signal and upweights singletons, which are more likely to arise from sequencing errors. Second, the fraction of ambiguous reads, fragmentary sequences, and hypothetical proteins in UniRef50 is markedly higher than in UniRef100. Third, specific functional classes are depleted under 50 % 50\% -identity clustering. blocks.en: The supervised tasks in our rubric come from the 18 18 -task suite curated by Chen et al. [2025] , which includes tasks from FLIP [ Dallago et al., 2021 ] and TAPE [ Rao et al., 2019 ] , among others. These tasks span four biological categories (structure, developability, interaction, and function) and include classification (C) and regression (R) at the residue, sequence, and sequence-pair levels. Examples include secondary structure, fold, fluorescence, stability, GB1 fitness, DeepLoc localization, and solubility prediction. We use the same tasks and metrics with three changes: we evaluate residue-level SSP with both Q 3 3 and Q 8 8 variants on the pooled test set, omit contact-map prediction because it overlaps with our zero-shot CASP16 contact probe (§ C.1.1 ), and replace the original probe with a tuned two-layer MLP head (§ C.2 ). Table 2 summarizes the resulting 18 18 tasks, and Table 5 compares baseline AMPLIFY models with our recursive variant after 1 1 M training steps.

blocks.en: Le Breton et al. [2026] find that the aggregate F1/MCC score across the 18 tasks differs by less than 5 % 5\% among 5 5 pLMs (AMPLIFY 120 120 M/ 350 350 M, ESM-2 35 35 M/ 150 150 M/ 650 650 M). To separate genuine pretraining signal from task-intrinsic ceiling effects, they measure the score gap between a shallow head on pretrained embeddings and the same head on randomly initialized weights, averaged over the five models. The results show that only four tasks account for essentially all the pretraining boost: stability prediction ( + 57.7 % +57.7\% ), fold prediction ( + 44.0 % +44.0\% ), and secondary-structure prediction ( + 30.4 % +30.4\% Q 3 3 , + 33.7 % +33.7\% Q 8 8 ). Every other task either saturates, with random embeddings already recovering most of the accuracy, or depends on features that MLM captures only weakly. For instance, TCR-pMHC affinity is 25 % 25\% lower with pretrained embeddings than with random ones. We follow this observation and report the four structural/stability-sensitive tasks (fold, SSP mean of Q 3 3 and Q 8 8 , stability, and localization) in the main-paper Table 1 and Appendix Table 3 . We further detail these tasks below.

[2026]发现,在18个任务中F1/MCC的总分在5个PLM(AMPLIFY 120 120 M/350 350 M,ESM-2 35 35 M/150 150 M/650 M)中差异小于5%. 为了将真正的预训信号从任务-内置天花板效应中分离出来,它们会测量被预训嵌入物上浅头和同头在随机初始化权重上的得分差距,平均在五个模型上. 结果显示,只有四项任务基本上占了所有训练前助推量:稳定性预测(+57.7%+57.7\%),折叠预测(+44.0%+44.0\%),以及二级结构预测(+30.4%+30.4\%Q 3 3,+33.7%+33.7\%Q 8 8 ). 所有其他任务要么是饱和体,随机嵌入体已经恢复了大部分精度,要么是依赖于MLM只能被弱取来的特点. 例如,TCR-pMHC的亲和性比预训嵌入法低25%-25%-%。 我们遵循这一看法,并在正文表1和附录表3中报告四个结构/稳定敏感的任务(问题3和8的SSP平均值、稳定性和本地化)。 下文进一步详述这些任务。

We use the DeepSF split with 12,312 12{,}312 train and 3,244 3{,}244 test samples. Because remote homologs are grouped into the same fold, high accuracy requires representations that recognize structural similarity across sequences with < 25 % <25\% identity. This is exactly the regime where handcrafted alignment features fail and where pretraining should help. The metric is the sequence-level total accuracy (top-1 fold match) [ Rao et al., 2019 , Fox et al., 2014 ] .

blocks.en: C.2 Task Head and Hyperparameter Search for Downstream Supervised Tasks
blocks.zh: C.2 任务主管和超参数搜索下游监督任务

blocks.en: During evaluation of the downstream supervised tasks, the encoder is frozen. Embeddings are extracted once and cached: the recurrent-core state for fixed- and variable-depth recAMPLIFY and the coda output for GMR variants and the final-layer output for AMPLIFY and ESM-2. Sequence-level tasks mean-pool over residue positions, excluding the special tokens. On top of these embeddings, we fit a two-layer MLP head (one hidden GELU layer) with a softmax output for classification and a single-scalar linear output for regression. Regression targets are standardized with the training set’s mean and standard deviation. The head is selected by a 50 50 -trial Bayesian TPE search over hidden size { 1024 , 2048 } \{1024,2048\} , learning rate [ 10 − 4 , 10 − 3 ] [10^{-4},10^{-3}] , number of epochs { 10 , 20 , 40 } \{10,20,40\} , weight decay [ 10 − 4 , 10 − 3 ] [10^{-4},10^{-3}] and batch size { 32 , 64 , 128 } \{32,64,128\} . For SSP, we instead search the corresponding exhaustive grid of 72 72 configurations. Each configuration is trained with early stopping on the task’s validation split (the dataset’s own split where provided, otherwise a random 10 % 10\% of the training set), and selection uses the task’s reported metric. The best configuration is then retrained with 5 5 random seeds and evaluated on the held-out test split. We report the mean (main-paper Table 1 ) and the standard deviation (Appendix Table 3 ).

blocks.en: Inspired by a recent line of work on recursive refinement in a limited-data regime, we ablate the effects of truncated backpropagation (BPTT) [ Jolicoeur-Martineau, 2025 ] and context type [ Liao and Poggio, 2026 ] . Figures 9 and 10 show that neither design helps at pretraining scale: truncated BPTT degrades fold, localization and SSP at every evaluation depth, and a learned context transform (fzL0) collapses, whereas the identity (‘zero’) and zL0 contexts perform comparably. We therefore train with full BPTT and an identity transformation of the previous cycle’s latent state.
blocks.zh: 受最近关于有限数据制度中递归性改进的一行工作的启发,我们缓解了短道速滑后植[Jolicoeur-Martineau,2025年]和上下文类型[Liao和Poggio,2026年]的影响。 图9和图10显示,这两种设计都无助于预先培训的规模:短线的BPTT在每次评价深度都会降解折叠,本地化和SSP,学习到的上下文会倒塌(fzL0),而身份("零")和zL0上下文的表现是相容的. 因此,我们用完整的BPTT和前一个周期潜伏状态的身份转变来训练。

blocks.en: The two mechanisms are the two sides of the same question — how many independent decisions does this residue distribution actually require? Overrepresentation of a hydrophobic residue is evolutionarily rare because random sequences with that composition would aggregate. The ones that survive do so through a specific fold or a membrane pocket, and recovering the wild-type residue at masked positions requires the model to integrate long-range structural evidence. Overrepresentation of any other residue is instead an alphabet-reduction cue, where once a polar or charged class dominates, many masked positions are predictable from local statistics and the model can commit early. The halt signal thus reads a reduced-alphabet grammar in the sense that restricted vocabularies get fewer cycles, unless the vocabulary happens to be the demanding kind.

blocks.en:
This is the first work targeting adaptive computation for test-time scaling of pLMs. As such, several caveats bound our claims. First, per-protein expected halt depth 𝔼 ⁡ [ k ] \mathbb{E}[k] varies within only ∼ 1 % \sim 1\% of its mean across the 10 10 K UniProt held-out set. GMR’s adaptivity is thus a small, structured modulation around a learned mean. Second, state-level convergence is characterized empirically through vanishing update norms and residual decay. We do not establish local stability of the recurrent operator via a Jacobian analysis. Third, gates are per-sequence rather than per-token, i.e., computation adapts across proteins but not within a sequence, and moving to per-token survivals is a natural extension.
Finally, all experiments are on recAMPLIFY variants trained under the AMPLIFY data recipe, and generalization to substantially different scales, architectures, or modalities remains open.
blocks.zh:
这是首个针对pLM的测试时间缩放的适应性计算的工作. 因此,我们的要求受到若干限制。 首先,每个蛋白质的预期停止深度 E [k]\ mathbb{E} [k] 仅在它的平均值的1%\sim 1 范围内,在10 K UniProt hold-out 的 10 组中存在差异。 GMR的适应性因此是一个小而有条理的调节,围绕一个有学问的平均值来进行. 第二,从经验上看,国家一级的趋同通过消失更新规范和残余衰减得到体现。 我们没有通过雅各比分析来建立经常操作者的地方稳定。 第三,门是按序列而不是按序列,即计算在蛋白质之间适应,但不在一个序列内,而向按序列生存的移动是一种自然延伸.
最后,所有实验都针对在AMPLIFY数据配方下培训的RecAMPLIFY变体,并且对大相径庭、结构或模式的概括仍然开放。

blocks.en: Figure 17 shows that removing input injection collapses the fixed-depth and the halt-only GMR states toward a null attractor with the halt-only variant’s decode particularly collapsing to a low-confidence generic token. In contrast, the scalar gate becomes more confident about a token that disagrees with its own input-injected prediction on ∼ 90 % \sim 90\% of positions. This is a specific artifact of residual gating with low degrees of freedom. With only one survival channel, the scalar gate’s survival distribution collapses to an input-invariant trajectory. The gate thus buys representational stability by substituting a stored default in place of a truly input-driven recurrence.
blocks.zh: 图17显示,除去输入注入会使固定深度和仅限停止的GMR向一个无效的吸引器倾斜,仅限停止的变体的解码尤其会崩溃为低信心的通用代号. 相对而言,平板门对一个与自己输入的预测有分歧的符号,对90%\sim 90\%位置的预测,则变得更加自信. 这是一种特殊文物 残留的鳄鱼 自由度低。 在只有一条生存通道的情况下,斯卡尔门的生存分布崩溃为输入-变化性轨迹. 因此,该门通过取而代之的存储默认取代真正由输入驱动的重复,从而购买了代表稳定性。
